noticias.titulo: TSMC chip capacity is ‘fierce’ battleground for AI customers, amid record quarter - CNBC
noticias.resumo:
TSMC makes the vast majority of the world's most advanced semiconductors, the graphics processors and central processors from Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom that are necessary for running AI workloads.  Now a growing number of tech firms – Apple, Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Meta and OpenAI – also rely on TSMC to make custom in-house AI accelerators. 

TSMC North American CEO Sajiv Dalal told CNBC he gets at least 10 calls a day about wafer capacity.
